question_summary: Submitter requests approval to substitute PEX piping in lieu of specified copper domestic water piping (Section 22 11 16) before ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use PEX piping as an alternate to copper for domestic water piping.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The request involves a substitution of a specified plumbing material (copper to PEX) under Division 22, requiring approval from the plumbing engineer of record.
